title: Exam Technique and Final Review

header.html: exam strategy and review of every domain
the official AZ-900 study guide, skills measured as of July 20, 2026

toc.title: Pairs the exam likes to confuse

html:
1The time budget

The assessment is 45 minutes. [Verify live] The number of questions is not given on the pages this course was built from, so check the exam page and divide the time by the count.

Step Time rule
First pass About one minute per question: answer what you know, mark the rest
Second pass Return to marked questions with the time left
Last minutes Make sure no question is left empty

Note

. Some exams contain sections that cannot be reviewed after you move on. Read the on-screen instructions before you start each section.

2The routine for every question

  1. Read the last sentence first: what is being asked (which service, model, benefit, tool)?
  2. Find the key need: "no servers to manage", "keep data in the country", "private connection", "enforce a rule", "prevent deletion".
  3. Name the category (compute, storage, networking, identity, governance, monitoring, cost) and drop options from other categories.
  4. Choose the most specific match for the need.
  5. Mark and move on if two options remain after a minute.

3Domain checklists

Cloud concepts (25–30%)

  • Shared responsibility: always the customer's data, devices, accounts and identities
  • Public, private and hybrid, with a use case for each
  • Consumption-based model; CapEx vs OpEx; reservations
  • Serverless = no server management, pay for execution
  • Benefits: high availability, scalability (up/out), reliability, predictability, security, governance, manageability
  • IaaS, PaaS, SaaS and who manages what

Azure architecture and services (35–40%)

  • Regions, region pairs, sovereign regions, availability zones, datacenters
  • Hierarchy: management group → subscription → resource group → resource
  • Compute: VMs, scale sets, availability sets, Azure Virtual Desktop, containers (ACI, AKS), Functions, App Service
  • Networking: VNet, subnet, peering, Azure DNS, VPN Gateway vs ExpressRoute, public vs private endpoint
  • Storage: Blob, Files, Queue, Table, Disk; tiers; LRS, ZRS, GRS, GZRS; AzCopy, Storage Explorer, File Sync; Azure Migrate, Data Box
  • Identity: Entra ID, Entra Domain Services, SSO, MFA, passwordless, external identities, Conditional Access, RBAC
  • Security: Zero Trust, defense in depth, Defender for Cloud

Management and governance (30–35%)

  • Cost factors, pricing calculator, Cost Management, tags
  • Purview, Azure Policy, resource locks
  • Portal, Cloud Shell, CLI, PowerShell, Azure Arc, IaC, ARM and templates
  • Advisor, Service Health, Azure Monitor (Log Analytics, alerts, Application Insights)

4Pairs the exam likes to confuse

Pair Tell them apart
VPN Gateway vs ExpressRoute encrypted over the internet vs private dedicated line
Scale set vs availability set identical autoscaling VMs vs fault and update domains
Zones vs region pair protect a datacenter failure vs a regional disaster
Azure Policy vs RBAC what configuration is allowed vs who can act
Policy vs locks enforce rules vs prevent delete or change
Advisor vs Service Health improve my setup vs Azure's own problems
Advisor vs Defender for Cloud general recommendations vs security posture and threats
Entra ID vs Entra Domain Services cloud identity vs managed domain (LDAP, Kerberos, group policy)
Pricing calculator vs Cost Management estimate a plan vs analyze what you spend
ACI vs AKS quick single containers vs orchestration
Authentication vs authorization who you are vs what you may do
Blob vs Files objects vs SMB/NFS file shares
Public vs private endpoint public IP vs private IP from your VNet
IaaS vs PaaS you patch the OS vs the provider does

5Common traps

  • "The provider is compliant, so I am." Compliance is shared.
  • Tags are inherited. Not by default.
  • Cheaper storage tier costs less to read. The opposite: cooler tiers cost more to access.
  • Zones work in every region. Not every region has zones.
  • A read-only lock only stops deleting. It stops modifying as well; the delete lock stops deleting only.
  • Azure DNS sells domain names. It hosts DNS records.
  • VPN Gateway avoids the internet. It encrypts traffic over the internet.
  • Serverless has no servers. The provider runs them.
  • Old names: Azure Active Directory = Microsoft Entra ID.

6The final week

Day Do
7–5 Re-read one module per day with the Quick Reference Card; answer its recall questions from memory
4–3 Do the comparison pairs table and the traps list out loud
2 Answer the practice questions in all modules again; note every miss
1 Light review of the cards; check the exam time, ID and online or test center rules; rest

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Mixed practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Fabrikam Outdoors wants to run a Windows server it fully controls, and it will patch the operating system itself. Which service type is this?

  • ASaaS
  • BIaaS
  • CPaaS
  • DServerless
Show the answer

Answer: B. Controlling and patching the OS is IaaS.

S2Which Azure feature protects a workload from the failure of one datacenter inside a region?

  • ARegion pairs
  • BResource tags
  • CAvailability zones
  • DAzure Advisor
Show the answer

Answer: C. Availability zones are separate locations inside a region.

S3A company needs a private, dedicated connection to Azure that does not use the public internet. What should it use?

  • AVPN Gateway
  • BExpressRoute
  • CVNet peering
  • DAzure DNS
Show the answer

Answer: B. ExpressRoute is a private connection through a provider.

S4Which role assignment lets someone manage resources but not give access to others?

  • AOwner
  • BReader
  • CGuest
  • DContributor
Show the answer

Answer: D. Contributor can create and manage resources but cannot assign roles.

S5Which storage option has the lowest storage cost but needs hours to read?

  • AHot
  • BArchive
  • CCool
  • DPremium
Show the answer

Answer: B. Archive is offline and must be rehydrated.

S6Which tool enforces that every resource has a CostCenter tag?

  • AAzure Policy
  • BResource locks
  • CAzure Monitor
  • DMicrosoft Purview
Show the answer

Answer: A. Azure Policy can require or add tags.

S7Which tool gives personalized recommendations for reliability, security, performance, cost and operational excellence?

  • AAzure Service Health
  • BAzure Arc
  • CCost analysis
  • DAzure Advisor
Show the answer

Answer: D. Advisor provides those five categories.

S8A resource group holds production resources that must not be deleted by mistake. What should be applied?

  • AA tag
  • BA budget
  • CA region pair
  • DA delete lock
Show the answer

Answer: D. A delete lock on the group protects everything in it.

S9Which model keeps some systems on-premises while using Azure for extra capacity?

  • APublic cloud
  • BPrivate cloud
  • CHybrid cloud
  • DServerless
Show the answer

Answer: C. Hybrid combines on-premises or private with public cloud.

S10An administrator wants to manage servers in another cloud from Azure with Azure Policy and tags. What fits?

  • AExpressRoute
  • BAzure Data Box
  • CAvailability sets
  • DAzure Arc
Show the answer

Answer: D. Azure Arc extends Azure management to non-Azure resources.

S11Which feature requires a second proof of identity, such as a code from a phone, in addition to a password?

  • ASingle sign-on
  • BRole-based access control
  • CMultifactor authentication
  • DA resource group
Show the answer

Answer: C. MFA requires two or more factors.

S12A team wants to estimate the cost of a planned deployment before creating it. Which tool should it use?

  • ACost analysis
  • BAzure pricing calculator
  • CAzure Service Health
  • DAzure Monitor
Show the answer

Answer: B. The pricing calculator estimates planned deployments.

7.2 Recall questions

R1Which three things are always the customer's responsibility?

Show the answer

Data, devices, and accounts and identities.

R2Order the Azure hierarchy from top to bottom.

Show the answer

Management group, subscription, resource group, resource.

R3Which services connect on-premises to Azure, and which one avoids the internet?

Show the answer

VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute; ExpressRoute avoids the public internet.

R4Name the Zero Trust principles.

Show the answer

Verify explicitly, use least-privilege access, assume breach.

R5Which tool queries logs with KQL?

Show the answer

Log Analytics (in Azure Monitor).

R6What do you read first in a question?

Show the answer

The last sentence.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Time 45 minutes; first pass, mark, second pass, no blanks
Method last sentence, key need, drop other categories, most specific match
Domains cloud concepts 25–30%; architecture and services 35–40%; management and governance 30–35%
Biggest confusions VPN vs ExpressRoute; Policy vs RBAC vs locks; Advisor vs Service Health vs Defender; zones vs region pairs
Traps shared compliance; tags not inherited; cooler tiers cost more to read; Azure AD is now Entra ID
